description: Everyone maneuvers within Rumia's dark domain, with dice checks and combat intertwined, ultimately breaking through the darkness to defeat Rumia and escape the forest path.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ru, Rumia? Are you alright?" #Steps forward, looking at Rumia with concern

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Four or five Ge Qings are chasing after her. In the distance, there's a fairy holding a vine.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: #Hugs Rumia lying on the ground "This method of directly infusing life force can slightly relieve the pain, but it's hard to cure."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Ahead is a girl holding a knife, trying to block her way. Despair. Is there any despair?

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "How tragic." #Puts down Rumia "She's fine, or rather, she's not fine, but it's our fault. Alright, let's continue on our way."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Rumia's tense voice relaxes. She isn't really injured.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: (This thing probably looks like this) [CQ:image,file=04CCAAA49743268BBF4C20A150392823.jpg,subType=0,url=https://multimedia.nt.qq.com.cn/download?appid=1407&fileid=EhQQSMrdNlL5ymXsOvvWB_FV1z0LcRi6yQIg_woo0aOO9bW9kAMyBHByb2RQgL2jAVoQanj7L2J6U0bkp4aLLVWrm3oCTeWCAQJneg&spec=0&rkey=CAESMEjDsbSBR3JOoFWiKkPr1hp_stXEHQhw9AZvA9Clo9rzPQhd24nKmM-VklNYYAGneA,file_size=42170][CQ:image,file=A227278ED92EED9A9EA16C7A3C52BB68.jpg,subType=0,url=https://multimedia.nt.qq.com.cn/download?appid=1407&fileid=EhTDPwW-pD7V_ZajRJCjDrVccRxq9Rih0gYg_woo3r6J9bW9kAMyBHByb2RQgL2jAVoQ35q78DqIb0MWsXK3pPoWf3oCn2SCAQJneg&spec=0&rkey=CAESMEjDsbSBR3JOoFWiKkPr1hp_stXEHQhw9AZvA9Clo9rzPQhd24nKmM-VklNYYAGneA,file_size=108833] "Ru... Rumia, are you alright? Do you need to go to a clinic or something?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Rumia lies on the snow, breathing steadily. Her consciousness hasn't returned yet.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Folds the Saw Cleaver and hangs it on the back.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: But it's nothing serious.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "So, shall we continue towards the Human Village?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let her stay here."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: After the battle with Rumia, you've wasted a lot of time. As the darkness dissipates, the exit of the forest is ahead. Following the path, the Human Village is not far.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's go. Rumia will be fine here."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Won't... won't she catch a cold or something?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Youkai and humans are different."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Oh, is that so?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I think we probably can't catch colds."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see..."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Heads towards the Human Village.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In the middle of winter, Rumia always wears her dress, so she definitely won't catch a cold. Long'er leads everyone towards the Human Village. About three minutes later, boot soles finally step onto the compacted dirt road. The forest's gloom is left behind, and a winding country path on the snowy plain lies ahead. Wheel ruts and footprints crisscross into a mottled texture on the frozen road surface. The tilted mailbox by the roadside is filled with snow. In the distance, the outlines of sporadic field ridges appear. The wind begins to carry the scent of firewood and miso. The Human Village is not far; the shadow of the village ahead can be faintly seen. Continue along the path.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Speaking of which, I'm not very familiar. Who does everyone think could do something on such a large scale?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "A youkai? It's very likely a youkai did it."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I don't know either."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Not sure."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I imagine the villagers are having a hard time too..." #Gazes at the distant village.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Passing through the last patch of shrubs hanging with icicles, the frozen path ends at the wooden boundary marker of the Human Village. Snow-covered roofs stretch to the horizon. A few resilient lanterns cast warm yellow halos in the dusk. A tilted "Sake" sign by the road is half-buried in snow. In the distance, the muffled sound of pounding mochi can be heard. Compared to the deathly silence of the forest, this messy, trivial human warmth makes you all sigh in relief. Finally, a more cozy place.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "A youkai...? Right, after all, human power couldn't do something like this, could it?" .st mp+3

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Walk over and pull the wine character signboard out of the snow, replanting it to the side

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Before you, the Human Village gate beside the boundary marker stands wide open, a wave of steaming heat rushing towards you. Inside the gate, the street is decorated with lanterns and streamers, vendors' cries mixing with the aroma of oden swirling in the flying snow. Children holding candied haws chase each other under eaves hung with icicles. When the tavern curtain is lifted, the sounds of shamisen and laughter spill out. The entire long street resembles a flowing river of warmth; even the snowflakes falling before the pottery stall turn into gold foil under the lantern light. The Human Village seems to be celebrating the New Year.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "The incident has just begun, it won't cause too much commotion yet."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The Human Village is quite lively.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see, no wonder it's still so lively here."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: You are standing at the entrance.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Wow, it's so lively even in this weather."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Wait a moment, I want some oden."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Ah... It's been so long since I've seen such a lively scene since going to Miss Yuyuko's place." "I want some too!"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Come to think of it, this is my first time here, everything is so new to me."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The oden street vendor is not far from you, a seemingly honest uncle standing there.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "On such a cold day, you just have to eat something hot and steaming..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Please make it quick."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Greet everyone and then walk towards the oden stall.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Uncle, give me some oden, can I take it to go?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Before you is a dark-skinned uncle with a white headband. In front of him, steaming oden bubbles and boils. "Sure," the boss nods.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Boss, boss, I want a portion too, with extra meatballs and broth at the end." #Eyes shining while looking at the oden in the pot.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Okay," the boss smiles, your enthusiastic attitude making him enthusiastic too. He quickly packs two portions of oden and hands them to you. "Thank you for your patronage," the boss nods.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Two of each, please." #Take out the pocket money given by Mokou to pay.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The boss takes the money. Long'er's oden is already packed and placed in front of him.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Thank you, boss!" #Hand the carried change to the boss, then secretly toss a portion of the oden into his own shadow, after which a mass of shadow wriggles and eats the discarded oden.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The shopkeeper takes the money and gives you a slight bow. The streets of the Human Village are lined with stalls everywhere, decorated with lanterns and streamers.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Hmm... do you need that thing called money to eat?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Taking the oden, Long'er glances at the snow still falling from the sky and subtly uses her ability to freeze the oden's state.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The Terakoya is not far from here.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Um... Miss Lina and Miss Ge Qing, would you like some? It's really delicious, this." #Runs to the two and holds the steaming bowl out to them.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Humans need it for trade, but youkai mostly barter." #Continues leading the way to the Terakoya.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As you walk and eat, the pressure on you seems to ease a bit with the lively atmosphere of the Human Village.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The Terakoya where the shrine maiden of the Hakurei Shrine is should be around here, right?" #Mouth full of meatballs, speaking unclearly.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "It should be."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: You cross a street, turn a corner, and as you approach the Terakoya, two figures catch your attention.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: In front of a stall selling sugar figurines, two girls are huddled under a glass lamp, carefully selecting them. A white-haired girl wearing a slightly worn apricot-colored haori, its hem stained with some ash, pants covered in many strange talismans, has a背影 that feels familiar to Long'er. She's holding a bamboo skewer,反复端详 the晶莹 rabbit sugar figurine. Her silver-haired companion, draped in a madder-red cotton cloak, a wooden hairpin loosely in her hair, gently按住 the other's晃来晃去 wrist, pointing to the freshly poured phoenix sugar painting, the corners of her eyes curved in a gentle arc.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Mokou."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hmm?" The girl in the haori turns around and sees a familiar person. The human form of the immortal Fujiwara no Mokou. "Ah, isn't this Long'er?" She points at Long'er, looking very happy.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Consciously steps back a little to give some distance.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Where did you run off to this morning?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: #Takes a few steps back.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Beside her, her silver-haired companion also turns at the right moment. The half-beast who devours history, Kamishirasawa Keine.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Went to find someone. On the way, I brought oden for you and Kamishirasawa-sensei. Just bought it."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Keine nods, then stands up and gives you a slight bow. Mokou casually takes the oden. "Thanks. Are these your friends?" Mokou points at the others. "I'm Fujiwara no Mokou. That's Keine," she points beside her. "Nice to meet you. Hope Long'er hasn't caused you any trouble."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hello, Miss Mokou. Hello, Miss Keine." #Bows to the two. "I'm Luo Xueyu. First time meeting you, please take care of me."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Just met them today. This is Lina, this is Ge Qing, this is Luo Xueyu." #Introduces the three teammates to Mokou.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As she speaks, she takes the sugar figurine handed by the vendor. It's a cherry blossom tree.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Mokou, I want a sugar figurine."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hello~" Mokou waves. "Hello, Xueyu," Keine nods at you.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Long'er is amazing. She defeated Rumia in just a couple of hits. If it were me, it wouldn't have been that fast."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Buy it yourself," Mokou waves her hand. "Rumia?" Keine tilts her head. "What about her?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Walks to the front of the sugar figurine stall to see what sugar paintings are available.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Miss Keine, I wonder if Reimu has looked for you?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The one who blocked our path earlier seemed quite different from her usual self?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: There are many finished sugar paintings: dragons, sheep, and various sugar figurines. In front of the vendor's stall is a pool of syrup, suggesting custom orders are possible.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Her usual self? Isn't that how Miss Rumia normally is?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Reimu?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "I'll have one of her." #pointing at Mokou

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "She came by in a hurry and left just now."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Seems we just missed her."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The vendor glanced at Mokou, smiled at your interesting dynamic, and began pouring the syrup.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Please excuse us. We're actually here looking for her again this time."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: A dark line appeared on Keine's forehead.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #squatting there watching the sugar painting master draw Mokou's sugar figurine

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As she spoke, she undid her hairpin.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Spring Energy..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Because spring has been arriving a bit late recently, and Reimu saw strange floating light spots around, she came to ask me about it."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Spring Energy?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "You must have seen them if you came here from the Bamboo Forest of the Lost."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "We saw it on our way from near the Hakurei Shrine. The Spring Energy was being sucked underground."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "They are the manifestation of spring among the four seasons."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "How terrible..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Who would collect such a thing..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Underground..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "How could anyone do such a thing, this is really... too much." #said somewhat indignantly

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "The dissipation of Spring Energy is clearly man-made."

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: #Long'er is squatting there watching the sugar figurines, verbally responding to the teammates' conversation.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "After Reimu heard about this concept, she went off to attack the Scarlet Devil Mansion again..."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "The Scarlet Devil Mansion? That very large Western-style mansion?"

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Although I really like winter, a winter without summer is also incomplete."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "She speculated that the head of that household is collecting Spring Energy, trying to create snow clouds covering all of Gensokyo."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? Huh?!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "This is a bit too..."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Miss Remilia probably wouldn't dare anymore"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Right by the Misty Lake"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "I see..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "She's just a child, she probably couldn't do something like this"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: I wonder if she can see her own bad luck today...

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Keine said while pulling out a book from somewhere
